
## Read in Datasets 

Need the PM2.5 data (48 hr hh mean) from the pm2.5 data files 
Need the household survey results from each of the surveys
```{r}
hh_pm <- read_rds(hh_pm_data_location)
hh_survey <- read_rds(hh_survey_location)

hh_survey %>% left_join()

hh_survey %>% count(hh_id) %>% arrange(desc(n))

```

hh_pm %>% count(hh_id) %>% count(n)
